design.amplitude_interpretation: scale cancels under within-species ranks at zero noise; practical infinite-SNR ceiling

interpretation.power: At least one frozen topology remains below 0.80 even with zero measurement noise, so increasing trait amplitude cannot rescue the current estimator on this benchmark.
interpretation.type1: Private zero-noise worlds reach 0.12 point rejection in some layouts. With only seven possible inter-basin cut positions, independent private transitions can coincide by chance; a zero-centered held-out-species null can therefore be too narrow on coarse discrete geography.
interpretation.coverage: Simple boundary crossing is not sufficient to explain the failure: layout 8 has the lowest mean held-out crossing fraction but power 1.00, whereas layout 4 has higher crossing coverage but power 0.75.
interpretation.next_step: Use oracle-boundary diagnostics to separate training-field learning from held-out scoring/inference, then design a geometry-conditioned chance-commonness null if required. Empirical DNA remains sealed.
